text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the URA Awards ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A truly illustrious lineup had gathered at 
the venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen, Mihono Bourbon, Oguri Cap, 
and Symboli Rudolf...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In her acceptance speech, Narita Brian 
issues a declaration of war to everyone. 
"Care to compete for the pinnacle?"—
